The repositories don't contain a written community decision, so the answer below is reconstructed from code and commit history. I used my search budget (10 search calls) before I could read the #3403 PR description or any ticket text, so I could not confirm the intent behind it.

**What the conditions list shows now.** Commit `64d3c99` ("Filter conditions query to problem-list-item category (#3403)") changed the conditions fetch to request only `category=…|problem-list-item`. That is the closest thing to a decision I found. It implies the conditions list is the longitudinal problem list, and diagnoses recorded through a visit note (which are not problem-list items) stay out of it and show under their visit instead. This is an inference from the code, not a documented decision.

**Why it needed a reload.** `invalidateVisitAndEncounterData` refreshes visit and encounter SWR keys only. Nothing in the notes app mutates the `Condition` key, so the conditions list keeps its cached data after a visit note is saved. The reload fix is inferred from the absence of a conditions mutate call in the save path.

**What else had to be fixed for visit diagnoses to show under the right visit.** Commit `1a2af77` (O3-5822) added `dedupeDiagnoses`, which sorts by rank and collapses the same diagnosis recorded across several encounters of one visit. It is used by the visit history diagnoses cell and the visit summary. Commit `52ad564` (O3-5990) makes the note save refresh visit-note data once per attempt, including saved diagnoses.

**Tickets and commits.** The implementing tickets I could see in commit messages are O3-5822 (dedupe) and O3-5990 (refresh after save). #3403 names no ticket. O3-5823 (rank and certainty in the visit note) is related but I did not verify its role.

Paths are cited as `<repo>/<path>`, as the Falkon instructions require, not as bare repo-relative paths.
